description: Check an owned linked sportsbook accountId for new bets, the same import the app runs: queues one history check for the account’s linked books (each allowed sportsbook is asked for its newest bets) and returns the check id and its state. Repeats within 30 seconds are refused with sync_cooldown; an unknown accountId is refused. Read progress with list_sportsbooks.
name: refresh_sportsbook
title: Refresh a sportsbook
